current_experiment: Closed80-output water-coordinate conditioning comparison, no_consistent_advantage. No current assignment, endpoint, sampling or output changed.
question: On the existing water_fixed_seed3 scaffold, does exposing the fixed protein and substrate sidechain geometry to native LigandMPNN improve independent recovery of the whole catalytic motif and intended substrate arrangement?
why_this_instead_of_more_RFD3_or_water_s: The observed candidate recovers its overall scaffold and local water position, but its catalytic donor and intended substrate geometry are displaced. A supported native sequence-conditioning switch tests a concrete possible translation gap while holding the already-generated backbone fixed. This is more informative than simply generating more water-ablation scaffolds.

selection.scope: Chosen after viewing fold/water recovery and donor/substrate displacement; any future result is exploratory and local to this scaffold, not confirmation of a general conditioning advantage.

conditions.meaning: No protein sidechain geometry revealed as atomized context; fixed amino-acid identities/backbone and actual Zn/water ligand context remain.
Reveal the fixed-residue sidechain geometry through the native LigandMPNN inference mechanism.

proposed_contrast.held_fixed: Same existing scaffold, full12merALQSSWGMMGML, G7-M8 identity, five catalytic residue identities, all substrate identities, chemical species, checkpoint, temperature and equal sequence budgets. New matched sequence seeds and finite budget must be frozen before a separately authorized future run.
proposed_contrast.interpretation: Combined fixed-sidechain-context ablation: five enzyme catalytic residues AND all12 fixed substrate residues (where sidechains exist). It is not a Tyr-only intervention and cannot isolate Tyr causality. Finite nearest-context selection can alter ligand exposure as sidechain atoms are added.
proposed_contrast.next_readout: Unconditioned prediction of each complete designed sequence and complex, with whole motif/substrate recovery and fold agreement defined prospectively. Preserve every assigned sequence and failed/missing output; do not reuse the closed water-primary outcome as the new objective.
proposed_contrast.stopping: No new execution under the closed run. Before any future sampling, confirm actual native feature masks/context match both intended conditions. Bound the subsequent sequence experiment prospectively and stop at that budget; a negative result closes this local conditioning hypothesis for this scaffold, not universal enzyme feasibility.

causal_limit: Source code proves a different conditioning path is available. It does not prove omission of this context caused the observed donor displacement, nor that enabling it improves structure or activity.
biochemical_limit: Any eventual function claim still needs identified G7-M8 products and matched enzyme-normalized rates; KM is not bindingKd. No laboratory work, ordering or outreach is proposed as already executed.
